method: Actual ensureAtlas/ensureCatalogData and actual AtlasMap class with deferred I/O and renderer boundaries; checks dependency overlap and lifecycle, not browser timing.

cases.name: Renderer opens the base before the catalog; geography and the catalog-backed year commit wait for both
A fast catalog never bypasses renderer or base readiness
Concurrent callers share one startup and later callers reuse the same map
Catalog rejection is immediately observed; its late renderer cannot resurrect a failed attempt
Catalog failure destroys an already constructed pending base and permits retry
A failed old renderer branch cannot overwrite a newer successful attempt
Renderer failure is observed while catalog is pending and keeps the cached catalog retryable
Base failure before catalog completion is handled and removes the failed instance
Navigating away before renderer arrival creates no map
Navigating away during the catalog wait destroys the base without starting geography
The latest year is applied when startup dependencies finish
Real AtlasMap defers optional geography and starts it exactly once
Real AtlasMap destruction cancels pending readiness and prevents late layer creation
Deferred geography preserves ordinary regional, frozen and street layers above water
Comparison-map default still initializes geography on base load
Real map readiness reports initialization errors and clears its deadline
No asynchronous startup failure escapes as an unhandled rejection
